recap: Darius Garland led the Cavaliers with 24 points (11-19 FG, 1-5 3PT), 4 rebounds and 9 assists.
Bradley Beal led the Wizards with 22 points (8-18 FG, 1-3 3PT), 8 rebounds and 5 assists.
CLE won 3 of 4 factors: shooting, ball security, second chances. Effective FG% 57.5 to 51.3.
Biggest swing: Mamadi Diakite blocks Kristaps Porzingis's 2-foot cutting layup shot (Q3 2:15), +6 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): Osman, LeVert, Garland, Mobley, Rubio, +8 in 6:12.
Bench points: CLE 40, WSH 29. Points in the paint: 78–48. Second-chance points: 11–11.
